caveats: The temporary patch is for pricing only; it is not merged or gate-tested.
Rust validity does not establish K-text identity or runtime equivalence. No such comparison was performed.
Owned cloning, eager collection and FIFO storage change allocation/lifetime costs; no performance claim is made.
The visitor rewrite introduces a current associated-projection diagnostic at scoped_locals.rs:28. Counts are attached to this valid-Rust probe, not represented as diagnostics of the untouched tree.
One Environment::key helper body is added; no existing compiler body is omitted.

measured.sourceBodyCountMeaning: complete pipeline attempted counts source functions with bodies in the loaded closure, including the supplied source library and source-generated methods; it is not a count of successful K bodies.
measured.baselineInterpretation: Recovered observations while ordinary compilation stops at parsing; excluded from distance estimates.
measured.finalSemanticCensusDifference: The semantic summary filters six unsupported expression/local-declaration diagnostics. The actual stderr contains 310 non-blocked diagnostics plus one E_BLOCKED summary.

decisionEvidence: The narrow 15-file probe crosses all observed item-level barriers without deleting a body or changing trusted K rules.
Half of the 100 unsupported diagnostics are extend (25), collect (13) and entry (12); most remaining methods use ordinary collections/text and existing K.
Of 48 borrow diagnostics, 19 forbid owned containers of views, 20 are exclusive conflicts, 7 shared conflicts, and 2 move/drop through a borrow/index.
The AST already stores edges as arena indices and most compiler state is owned. No observed blocker forces a new trusted K rule.
A byte-identical rewrite would still have to recover declaration/type/local/function numbering, instantiation order, cleanup order and source locations; current code preserves those decisions.
next: Land only deliberate declaration/representation rewrites after review and an exact-K baseline is retained.
Treat type-context/map-index/borrowed-key and reusable library gaps as consumer-driven ordinary work; use explicit loops/helpers for rare iterator/entry/mutable-iterator patterns.
Replace heap views by owned IDs or values; separate receiver reads from mutable calls.
Recount after first faults are removed, then expose remaining ownership errors; do not interpret 310 as all remaining edits.
Compare K bytes on conformance and the compiler source, then complete source-producer self-build/fixed point.

commands.probe: Run scripts 01 through 08 in numeric order on a fresh copy of the saved baseline, running the saved b0 check --census probe/src/frontend.rs after each stage.
